Irene (CS): Quick flag: Veridian Labs spiked to 88% of monthly credits in 24h. QBR in 5 days. Theyre worried about overages and want a clear remediation plan.
Cal (AE): Which product flows?
Irene (CS): Mix of long-form generation and new vector refreshes for search. Embeddings particularly heavy after they reran the full index.
Nate (Solutions Eng): Fast wins: 1) Pause full index refresh and run incremental updates; 2) Batch embed requests (batch_size=256); 3) Suggest smaller embed model for low-value docs.
BudgetBot: alert: account_usage.veridian > 80% monthly_credits (triggered at 2987654333).
Penny (Finance): If they hit >95% pre-renewal it changes renewal tiers. Need a 3-scenario spend table for the QBR.
Cal (AE): Customer wants non-disruptive options. Can we offer an opt-in "index window" that runs off-peak plus a temporary soft cap?
Nate (Solutions Eng): Yep. Proposal: schedule index refresh between 02:00-05:00, enable batching and dedupe, and provide an opt-in soft cap for last 7 days of cycle. Snippet for Console policy:
```yaml
name: veridian-index-softcap
scope: org:veridian
window: last_7_days
trigger: projected_monthly > tier_limit
action: throttle_index_refresh: true
opt_in: true
notify: [irene@redwood.com, cal@redwood.com]
```
Irene (CS): I'll run an enablement call with their infra team tomorrow 9am PT to walk the index plan and capture feedback.
Penny (Finance): I'll populate the spend scenarios: baseline, incremental+batching, and incremental+batching+model-sub. Use conservative savings (25% for batching+dedeupe, +10% if they pick smaller embed model).
Cal (AE): I'll draft the one-pager for the QBR highlighting root cause, mitigations taken, projected spend, and a recommended commit ask.
Irene (CS): Action items: Cal - one-pager; Irene - enablement + notes; Nate - batching + incremental PR; Penny - spend scenarios. I'll post graphs and runbook here after the call.
BudgetBot: note: ticket CS-9777 created for Veridian index and cost mitigation.
